domain.name: abstract Fano point-line incidence, successor presentation
domain.description: The finite projective plane PG(2,2), represented only by two opaque seven-element sorts and their incidence relation. This successor presentation declares source structure and an answer type, and declares no map from inputs to answers.
domain.source_semantics: A point-line pair is marked exactly when its two opaque members occur in one declared incidence row. Raw identifiers carry no order, coordinate, probability, or answer meaning.
domain.difference_from_predecessor: The predecessor declared a total decision rule over the admitted inputs. This successor removes it. The sorts, the relation, the admitted inputs, the presentation equivalence, and the automorphism definition are carried over unchanged.

admitted_inputs.generator: Every ordered pair (point, line) from the two declared sorts.

equivalence.raw_presentation_equivalence: Two raw presentations of an admitted input are equivalent exactly when a sort-preserving incidence automorphism carries one point-line pair to the other.

automorphisms.definition: All independent point and line permutations that preserve the declared incident relation.
automorphisms.expectation_status: redundant self-check on a quantity the compiler derives independently from the sorts and the relation alone

derivable_self_checks.naming_constraint: Derived classes are reported as O_0 and O_1, ordered by cardinality then by least member. The names are bookkeeping and carry no answer meaning.
derivable_self_checks.expectation_status: redundant self-check; the compiler reads only sorts and relations and must reproduce these numbers without consulting this block

answer_type.name: BinaryAnswer
answer_type.semantics: Two neutral, unordered, mutually exclusive and exhaustive answer labels. The labels are opaque names with no source meaning and no declared relationship to any sort, relation, or derived class.

not_declared_here: any total or partial assignment from admitted inputs to answer labels
any statement that the declared relation determines an answer label
any decision procedure of any kind
compiler_visible_semantics: the induced incidence automorphisms and the induced equivalence classes on admitted inputs
the arity and the neutral labels of the answer type
compiler_forbidden_semantics: answer label stored as an input field

preexisting_source_authority.independence_fence: The frozen object is the abstract unlabeled incidence quotient already recovered and banked by Issue 011. It does not reuse the FIPS Event catalogue, habitat supports, hidden FFF labels, learning targets, or any OT preparation representation.
